name: Petrangola
description: Petrangola is a card game from the Italian provinces of Marche and Romagna, also known as 31. Players have three cards each and improve their hands by exchanging with three face-up table cards; aim is high total in one suit (max 31) or a petrangola (three equal or three of a suit in sequence).
